modules.name: Among Us
modules.note: Unity 2022.3, Direct3D 11, Rewired for input. Checked on the Steam copy, Wine 11.20 (Magic Kettle builds 10 and 11), on an M2 Max. On build 10 the game hung for good after its intro on every backend: its first XInput call waited for Wine's controller thread, which waited for the window lock. MagicKettle-Runtime build 11 fixes that in Wine (patch 0012), so nothing here works around it.

fixes.note: With XInput working, DXVK reaches the main menu and plays. D3DMetal crashed in UnityPlayer.dll right after creating its device (read of address 0x20), so DXVK goes first and D3DMetal never needs its turn. DXMT wasn't checked with XInput fixed.

modules.name: Before We Leave
modules.note: Unity 2019.4, Direct3D 11. Checked on the Epic Games Store copy, Wine 11.20 (Magic Kettle build 9), on an M2 Max. The Steam copy (1073910) is matched too but not checked yet.

fixes.note: With DXVK, the auto choice for Direct3D 11, the game's full-screen window stayed black: the game ran and DXVK presented, but no picture appeared. With DXMT the menu shows and the buttons work. Required, not preferred: the black window counted as a start, so DXVK was remembered as working and a preference never got its turn.

modules.name: Gale
modules.note: Gale, a Thunderstore mod manager. Its ProductName, "Gale" (productName in its src-tauri/tauri.conf.json), is too common a word to go by alone, so it is found with its exe's name, gale.exe, as its installer put it in Magic Kettle. The cover is Magic Kettle's own: the program's logo from its repository on a background in its colours, with its name. Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.

modules.name: Hedge Mod Manager
modules.note: HedgeModManager, the mod manager for Sonic games. Version 7 says "Hedge Mod Manager" (its AssemblyInfo.cs); version 8 is a single-file .NET program whose exe carries its main assembly's name, "HedgeModManager.UI", checked on 8.0.0 beta 7 in Magic Kettle. The cover is Magic Kettle's own: the program's logo from its repository on a background in its colours, with its name. Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.

modules.name: Mania Mod Manager
modules.note: ManiaModManager, from Sonic Retro's Sonic Mania mod loader. It works on the folder it is in, so it sits in Sonic Mania's folder. Found by its ProductName, "ManiaModManager" (AssemblyProduct in its Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs); not yet read from a real copy. Its repository has no license, so the cover leaves its icon to the player's own exe. The cover is Magic Kettle's own, with no art of anyone else's: the program's name on a background of its own colours, with room in the rings for the program's icon, which the app takes from the player's own exe (cover.icon). Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.

credits.what: cover, made for Magic Kettle without any third-party art

modules.name: Nexus Mods App
modules.note: The Nexus Mods app. It sets no ProductName of its own, so .NET writes its assembly name, "NexusMods.App" (src/NexusMods.App/NexusMods.App.csproj and Directory.Build.props set none). Not yet checked on a real copy in Magic Kettle: only the cover depends on it. The cover is Magic Kettle's own: the program's logo from its repository on a background in its colours, with its name. Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.

credits.what: cover, made from the app's icon (Nexus-Icon.png)

modules.name: r2modman
modules.note: r2modman, the Thunderstore mod manager. Its one-file download carries its version in its name (r2modman-3.2.21.exe), so it is found by its ProductName, "r2modman", checked on 3.2.21 in Magic Kettle. The cover is Magic Kettle's own: the program's logo from its repository on a background in its colours, with its name. Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.

modules.name: SA Mod Manager
modules.note: SA Mod Manager (X-Hax), the mod manager for Sonic Adventure DX and Sonic Adventure 2. Found by its ProductName, "SAModManager", read from SAModManager.exe of release 1.3.7. Its own icon is Sonic's head, Sega's character, which X-Hax's MIT license doesn't cover, so the cover leaves it to the player's own exe. The cover is Magic Kettle's own, with no art of anyone else's: the program's name on a background of its own colours, with room in the rings for the program's icon, which the app takes from the player's own exe (cover.icon). Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.

credits.what: cover, made for Magic Kettle without any third-party art
